map.计算您每日总能量消耗，以及不同目标下的热量需求: Multiply your basal metabolic rate by an activity factor to get total daily energy expenditure, then show the cut, maintain and bulk calorie targets derived from it.
map.TDEE = BMR × 活动系数；减脂目标 = TDEE − 500，增肌目标: TDEE = BMR × activity factor; cut target = TDEE − 500, bulk target = TDEE + 300; thermic effect of food TEF = TDEE × 0.1
map.办公室工作，几乎不运动，日常活动极少: Desk job, little or no exercise, very low daily activity
map.每周1-3次轻度运动，或日常有较多步行: Light exercise 1-3 times a week, or plenty of daily walking
map.每周3-5次中等强度运动，或日常较活跃: Moderate exercise 3-5 times a week, or a fairly active daily routine
map.每周6-7次运动，或体力工作+运动: Exercise 6-7 times a week, or physical work plus exercise
map.重体力劳动，或每天2次高强度训练: Heavy physical labour, or two high-intensity workouts a day
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，不能替代专业医疗建议。实际热量需求受遗传、激素、药物等多种: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only and cannot replace professional medical advice. Actual calorie needs are affected by many factors such as genetics, hormones and medication.

map.科普教学：理解 BMR 与活动因子: Education: understand BMR and activity factors
map.算法：TDEE = BMR × 活动因子；减脂摄入 ≈ TDEE × 0.8（约: Algorithm: TDEE = BMR × activity factor; cut intake ≈ TDEE × 0.8 (about 20% less); weekly deficit needed = target weekly weight loss (kg) × 7700. Common activity factors are 1.2 sedentary, 1.375 light, 1.55 moderate, 1.725 high. All values must be >0.
map.例1（BMR 1500、活动 1.5、周减 0.5kg）：TDEE=1500×1: Example 1 (BMR 1500, activity 1.5, weekly loss 0.5 kg): TDEE = 1500 × 1.5 = 2250 kcal, cut intake 1800 kcal/day, weekly deficit 0.5 × 7700 = 3850 kcal. Example 2 (BMR 1400, activity 1.375): TDEE = 1925 kcal.
map.活动因子怎么选？: How do I choose an activity factor?
By your total daily energy expenditure: 1.2 sedentary, 1.375 light exercise, 1.55 moderate, 1.725 high intensity, higher for physical labour; choosing too high overestimates intake, so err on the low side.
map.约每周减 0.25–0.5kg 较安全；>25% 易掉肌肉代谢降。7700kca: Losing about 0.25-0.5 kg a week is fairly safe; more than 25% tends to lose muscle and slow metabolism. 7700 kcal ≈ 1 kg of fat is a convenient estimate.
